title: Diagnosing Faults in Reinforcement Learning Simulators and World Models with Canonical Polynomial Invariants
abstract: arXiv:2609.13194v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A large literature builds physical structure into learned dynamics on the premise that models respecting the underlying physics predict better. We test that premise using exact polynomial invariants recovered from trajectories and canonicalised as reduced Gr\"obner bases over $\mathbb{Q}$. On Acrobot, exactness provides little benefit for prediction: a consistency regulariser reduces algebraic residual while leaving rollout fidelity essentially unchanged, and a shaping potential recovered from a system with a 100% mass error accelerates learning as effectively as the correct potential. Exact canonical invariants instead prove valuable for diagnosis. We develop two procedures: screening, which identifies the violated physical constraint, and attribution, which recovers the faulty invariant and identifies the responsible physical parameter. translated_title: 利用规范多项式不变量诊断强化学习模拟器与世界模型中的故障
translated_abstract: 大量文献在所学的动力学模型中构建物理结构，其前提是尊重底层物理规律的模型具有更好的预测能力。我们使用从轨迹中恢复、并被规范化为 ℚ 上约化 Gröbner 基的精确多项式不变量来检验这一前提。在 Acrobot 环境上，精确性对预测几乎没有益处：一致性正则化器虽然降低了代数残差，但展开保真度基本不变；而从一个质量误差高达 100% 的系统中恢复出的塑形势能，与正确的势能一样能有效加速学习。相反，精确的规范不变量被证明在故障诊断中极具价值。我们提出了两种诊断程序：筛选，用于识别被违反的物理约束；归因，用于恢复出错的不变量并定位相应的物理参数。为实现这一目标，我们引入了标准型去缩放和商空间恢复技术。在十五个注入故障（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 本文的核心创新是提出了利用从轨迹恢复并规范为约化 Gröbner 基的精确多项式不变量，通过“筛选”与“归因”两种新程序（借助标准型去缩放和商空间恢复技术）来诊断强化学习模拟器与世界模型中的故障，并发现物理精确性对预测收益有限、但对故障诊断极为有价值。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces screening and attribution procedures—enabled by normal-form deflation and quotient-space recovery—that use exact canonical polynomial invariants (reduced Gröbner bases over ℚ) recovered from trajectories to diagnose faults in reinforcement learning simulators and world models, showing that physical exactness offers little predictive benefit but proves highly valuable for fault diagnosis.
